## Summary

Describe the problem and what this changes. Link related issues, if any.

## Validation

List checks run and their results. Explain any checks skipped.
For simulation changes, include relevant mission settings and controller mode.
For UI changes, add screenshots when useful.

- [ ] Type check (`npx tsc --noEmit`)
- [ ] Lint (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Build (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Relevant behavior verified (or not applicable, with explanation)

## Review checklist

- [ ] Documentation updated where needed
- [ ] No credentials or private data included
- [ ] Changes are focused on the described problem
